title: The Crab Derby, 2011
logline: Twenty-seventh annual. Gully's got a baby on his hip — his own. The flyer gets a fourth crab, very small.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY with a baby on his hip — a girl, one — and the twenty. WOOD. BARNABY, twelve, sniffing the baby's foot.

balloons.text: Twenty-seven. She's watching. Do it right.

image.prompt: a man in an apron with a baby girl on his hip holding out a twenty at a shop counter, a thin man with a pad, an old dog sniffing the baby's foot, muddy flats

panels.composition: The flyer: two crabs facing, a cup, the small third crab — and a fourth, tiny, between the two big ones.

image.prompt: close-up of a crab flyer with two large crabs facing each other, a cup, a small crab, and a tiny fourth crab between the two large ones

panels.composition: The baby reaching for the pen. Wood letting her hold it. A scribble on the corner.

image.prompt: a baby gripping a pen with a thin man's hand guiding it toward the corner of a flyer, a scribble appearing

panels.composition: Seventeen flyers. The seventeenth: four crabs and a scribble. Gully pinning with his free hand.

image.prompt: seventeen crab flyers on a shingle wall, a man with a baby on his hip pinning the newest one-handed, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: Gully's daughter, one, scribbles. Four crabs now.
